This page checks the spaces that sit at the edges of inline code and of block elements, where a converter can join two words or leave a stray space at the end of a line.

The export_name attribute names the symbol, and loand hi mark the range.

Inside code, runs of spaces and newlines collapse, `ticks` get padded, a `` b needs a longer fence, and blank code leaves a space.

Code in a link: link_code, and a strong one: bold_code text.

Term with code
number: integer, 0 to 9 inclusive, default 20
A loose line in a division with code

A paragraph inside a section, ending with a space.
